label: Security camera
intent: The camera spots movement and records it. Light: the camera snaps down about its wall joint onto the scene, stops dead, and the lens flashes once as recording starts; then it swings back up with a small overshoot and settles. Strong: it scans up first, sweeps down hard onto the target with a recoil, the lens flashes twice while it holds the view, and it swings back and settles. The arm, joint and wall plate never move.

body.//: v1's 14 x 9 r3 housing turned -14 degrees, exact path; v1 Solid is the hollow rim

camera.//: the housing turns on the ball joint at the end of the arm

lens.//: the recording flash swells from the lens centre
